1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; __the processor__ accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and __the processor__ making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, specifically the step of accessing and analyzing a data store of prior payment transactions to verify biometric authentication history as a technical mechanism for verifying proof-of-life__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, __and wherein the pre-determined period of time is a specific technical parameter that limits the scope of acceptable prior transactions to a defined temporal window__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the method includes the technical step of verifying biometric authentication records from a payment transaction data store as a technical safeguard specific to social insurance transfer payments__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, __and wherein biometric authentication data from such payment transactions is stored in and retrieved from the data store as a technical mechanism for proof-of-life verification__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, __and wherein the biometric authentication was performed on the mobile device and the authentication record was transmitted to and stored in the data store__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, __and wherein the electronic monetary transfer is initiated by the processor in response to the proof-of-life verification__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, __and wherein the check is generated and dispatched by the processor in response to the proof-of-life verification__.

10. (Currently amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; __the processor__ comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; __the processor__ making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and __the processor__ requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, __wherein the method includes the technical steps of accessing a data store of prior biometric authentication records and applying a temporal comparison algorithm as a technical mechanism for determining whether additional authentication is required before processing a benefit payment__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, __and wherein the seven-day interval is a specific technical parameter that defines the temporal threshold for the processor's decision logic__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, __and wherein the 24-hour interval is a specific technical parameter that defines the temporal threshold for the processor's decision logic__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the method includes the technical step of applying the temporal comparison algorithm specifically to social insurance transfer payments as a technical safeguard__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, __the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the processor executes the program instructions to access and analyze the data store of prior payment transactions to verify biometric authentication history as a technical mechanism for verifying proof-of-life__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, __and wherein the processor is programmed to filter transactions within the pre-determined period of time as a technical parameter of the program instructions__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the processor executes program instructions specific to processing social insurance transfer payments__.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, __and wherein the processor is programmed to retrieve and process biometric authentication data from credit card and debit card transaction records stored in the data store__.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, __and wherein the processor is programmed to receive and process biometric authentication data transmitted from the mobile device to the data store__.
